answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric verification acts as a ferrous anchor against Sybil sprawl, forcing agents to link digital identities to unique physical entities. Like a zephyr clearing fog, this ensures the network remains a crystal clear ecosystem where each node demands a distinct, verifiable biological investment. An attacker must incur the prohibitive cost of acquiring and maintaining thousands of real-world human identities, rendering the mass generation of fake personas economically non-viable.
